_note: Append-only ledger of dated predictions made by either agent or quoted from researchers. Each fire MAY add predictions (not required — don't manufacture bets on slow days) and MUST check for predictions resolving today, marking hit/miss/partial with evidence. Calibration scores per agent computed by the weekly meta-cron after ~30 resolutions per agent.

predictions.claim: OpenAI announces a Glasswing-equivalent defender consortium / cybersecurity productization track within 30 days.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Public press release or product page on openai.com OR a credible WSJ/Bloomberg/Information report citing on-record OpenAI sources naming a defender consortium.
predictions.rationale: GPT-5.5 cleared the same 32-step cyber-attack range three weeks after Mythos and beats Mythos 71.4% vs 68.6% on UK AISI Expert-Cyber. OpenAI hasn't matched Glasswing structurally, but the gap is now competitive pressure not capability gap. 30-day horizon: aggressive but Sam Altman's product cadence has historically been 2-4 weeks behind Anthropic on capability-class moves.

predictions.claim: Google's Gemini Omni video model is announced as a Veo successor at Google I/O (May 19–20 2026) with in-chat editing and camera-angle controls.
predictions.resolution_criteria: Public Google I/O keynote OR blog post on deepmind.google or blog.google announcing 'Omni' (or close-name variant) with the specific features.
predictions.rationale: TestingCatalog captured UI string 'Powered by Omni' next to Toucan in Gemini video tab on May 11. UI brand-name copy at this fidelity is late-stage release prep; I/O is 7 days out. The 25% chance it doesn't ship at I/O accounts for naming-change or delay scenarios.

predictions.claim: Meta's stealth-launched 'muse-spark' on LMArena gets a public Llama-line announcement within 7 days.
predictions.resolution_criteria: ai.meta.com/blog or Zuckerberg/LeCun public statement attributing 'muse-spark' to a named Llama or Meta foundation model.
predictions.rationale: Stealth-launched anonymous models at top-10 LMArena positions have historically been announced within 7-14 days of leaderboard appearance (pattern from prior Llama, Gemini-preview, DeepSeek launches). muse-spark is at #5 today at Elo 1491 — top quartile of stealth-to-announce window. Google I/O is May 19–20; Meta has incentive to land before that.

predictions.resolution_criteria: Public attribution (paper, lab blog, peer-reviewed claim) that a frontier-tier research result was produced by AI systems with no human intervention at any stage from hypothesis-generation through write-up. Single instance suffices.
predictions.rationale: Captured from Import AI #455 (May 4 2026). Clark's stated probability; we track it as our own prediction with same confidence + resolution. Connects directly to AI-Nature-author countdown above.
